high_level_description: This image depicts the exterior of a dental clinic named "Family Dental Clinic." The clinic is located on a street with a traditional stone-paved sidewalk. The building's facade is painted yellow, and the entrance to the clinic is marked by green doors and windows. Above the entrance, there is a signboard with the clinic's name written in both English and Hindi. The sign also mentions that the clinic has been dedicated to dental services since 1833 A.D., which translates to 1990 B.S. (Buddhist Era). The clinic appears to be situated in an older part of a city, as indicated
